mapper.update: UPDATE sub_task SET task_id = #{et.taskId}, module_id = #{et.moduleId}, title = #{et.title}, deliverable = #{et.deliverable}, acceptance = #{et.acceptance}, priority = #{et.priority}, status = #{et.status}, assigned_agent = #{et.assignedAgent}, content = #{et.content}, context = #{et.context,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, score_factors = #{et.scoreFactors,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, composite_score = #{et.compositeScore}, score_grade = #{et.scoreGrade}, deadline = #{et.deadline}, rework_count = #{et.reworkCount}, completed_at = #{et.completedAt}, version = #{et.version}, timeout_count = #{et.timeoutCount}, update_by = #{et.updateBy}, update_time = #{et.updateTime} WHERE id = #{et.id} AND version = #{MP_OPTLOCK_VERSION_ORIGINAL} AND deleted = 0
